entries.translation: Син кигән стиль. Син үзең белән йөрткән мәдәният.
entries.transliteration: Sin kigän stil. Sin üzeñ belän yörtkän mädäniyät.
entries.note: Informal singular; мәдәният preferred over Russian культура.

entries.translation: మీరు ధరించే శైలి. మీరు వెంట తీసుకెళ్లే సంస్కృతి.
entries.transliteration: Mīru dhariñcē śaili. Mīru veṇṭa tīsukeḷḷē saṃskṛti.
entries.note: Respectful మీరు; వెంట తీసుకెళ్లే conveys carrying with you.

entries.translation: Услубе, ки мепӯшӣ. Фарҳанге, ки бо худ мебарӣ.
entries.transliteration: Uslube, ki mepūshī. Farhange, ki bo khud mebarī.
entries.note: Informal singular; бо худ preserves identity metaphor.

entries.translation: Estilong suot mo. Kulturang taglay mo.
entries.note: Taglay means possess or embody; established estilo and kultura retained.

entries.translation: สไตล์ที่คุณสวมใส่ วัฒนธรรมที่คุณพกพา
entries.transliteration: Satai thi khun suam sai. Watthanatham thi khun phok pha.
entries.note: Standard fashion term สไตล์; natural Thai slogan spacing.

entries.translation: ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་གྱོན་པའི་བཟོ་ལྟ། ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་འཁྱེར་བའི་རིག་གཞུང་།
entries.transliteration: khyod kyis gyon pa'i bzo lta/ khyod kyis 'khyer ba'i rig gzhung /
entries.note: Standard Written Tibetan in Uchen; slogan rhythm merits native review.

entries.translation: ቅዲ ትኽደኖ። ባህሊ ትስከሞ።
entries.note: Masculine singular generic; regional native review advised.

entries.translation: Ko e founga teunga ʻokú ke tui. Ko e anga fakafonua ʻokú ke fua.
entries.note: Native paraphrase ‘way of dressing’; fua is the candidate for bearing culture; native review remains required.

entries.translation: Setaele se o se aparang. Setso se o se tshotse.
entries.note: Standard adapted setaele; parallel relative concords.

entries.translation: Xitayili lexi u xi ambalaka. Ndhavuko lowu u wu rhwalaka.
entries.note: Adapted xitayili; class concords preserve parallel syntax.

entries.translation: Geýýän stiliň. Özüň bilen göterýän medeniýetiň.
entries.note: Informal singular; explicit ‘with you’ prevents physical-only reading.

entries.translation: Giydiğin tarz. Taşıdığın kültür.
entries.note: Informal singular; native-standard tarz creates clean balance.

entries.translation: Style a wohyɛ. Amammerɛ a wosoa.
entries.note: Asante Twi; style retained as routine contemporary loan; native campaign review required.

entries.translation: سىز كىيگەن ئۇسلۇب. سىز ئېلىپ يۈرگەن مەدەنىيەت.
entries.transliteration: Siz kiygen uslub. Siz ëlip yürgen medeniyet.
entries.note: Respectful سىز; standard Arabic-script Uyghur.

entries.translation: Стиль, який носиш. Культура, яку несеш.
entries.transliteration: Styl, yakyi nosysh. Kultura, yaku nesesh.
entries.note: Pronoun omitted; носиш and несеш create deliberate sound balance.

entries.translation: انداز جو آپ پہنتے ہیں۔ ثقافت جو آپ ساتھ لیے چلتے ہیں۔
entries.transliteration: Andāz jo āp pahante hain. Saqāfat jo āp sāth liye chalte hain.
entries.note: Formal آپ; ساتھ لیے چلتے ہیں expresses culture carried through life.

entries.translation: Kiyadigan uslubing. Olib yuradigan madaniyating.
entries.note: Informal singular; matching habitual participles.

entries.translation: Tshitaila tshine wa ambara. Mvelele ine wa hwala.
entries.note: Adapted tshitaila; noun-class concord and campaign register need native review.

entries.translation: Phong cách bạn mặc. Văn hóa bạn mang theo.
entries.note: Natural elliptical advertising syntax; mang theo means carry along.

entries.translation: Maget, keli lenlabol. Kuliv, keli polol.
entries.note: Modern Volapük; accusative relative keli required for both objects.

entries.translation: Arddull rydych chi’n ei wisgo. Diwylliant rydych chi’n ei gario.
entries.note: Neutral formal or plural chi; masculine mutations checked.

entries.translation: Li stîle ki ti poites. Li culteure ki ti moennes avou twè.
entries.note: Rfondou walon chosen; strong regional variation makes native review essential.

entries.translation: Melokaan wi ngay sol. Cosaan wi ngay yor.
entries.note: Melokaan means look or style; cosaan foregrounds heritage and roots.

entries.translation: Isimbo osinxibayo. Inkcubeko oyithweleyo.
entries.note: Parallel relative clauses; object concords si- and yi-.

entries.translation: דער סטיל וואָס דו טראָגסט. די קולטור וואָס דו טראָגסט מיט זיך.
entries.transliteration: Der stil vos du trogst. Di kultur vos du trogst mit zikh.
entries.note: Informal singular; standard YIVO orthography.

entries.translation: Àrà tí o wọ̀. Àṣà tí o gbé.
entries.note: Full tone marks; gbé intentionally supports carry and live double meaning.

entries.translation: Yiengh mwngz daenj. Vwnzva mwngz dawz.
entries.note: Standard Zhuang, Wuming or Yongbei-based 1982 Latin orthography; expert review essential.

entries.translation: Isitayela osigqokayo. Isiko olithwalayo.
entries.note: Parallel relative clauses; object concords si- and li-.
